browser_check.scope: Local desktop/mobile browser and link rendering checks. Graph source URLs are checked against current local files/anchors; their not-yet-published remote GitHub HTTP status is not asserted.

exposition: Pulling order chooses compatible diagonals; ambient cell orientation determines positive tetrahedron shapes.
Defining face-map triples remain distinct; the two auxiliary fixed points themselves may coalesce at completeness.
corrections.reference: D.4.3, printed p127/PDF p140: the complete filling Jacobian is -2pi i diag(tau), not -4pi i diag(tau). Direct differentiation proves the corrected coefficient; invertibility and the local existence conclusion are unchanged. The reference PDF and mathematical TeX are untouched.

formal_replay.reuse_basis: Completed optional replay retained after all 32 recorded source hashes matched current files.

remaining_paper_boundaries: Completed-root nonzero local expansion, whole oscillatory filling sum and normalized quantum/classical action comparison.
Summed and directed circle-tree asymptotics, retaining their different quantitative hypotheses.
Broader strict-tangle extension with its additional normal forms and boundary estimates.
All-orders moving-meridian expansion, preferred geometric longitude and selected operator-factor theorems.

classical_fillings.conclusion: No missing mathematical premise found in the examined classical chain; two wording precisions incorporated.
corrections: Global pulling order selects diagonals; ambient-cell orientation supplies positive tetrahedra.
Defining face-map triples remain distinct; the auxiliary fixed points coalesce at completeness.
not_claimed: fresh proof of all upstream topological or normal-flow identities
classical_fillings.read_scope: Full three-file classical paper; source checker and directly used Marked completion/peripheral-volume/same-chain passages; prior complete-geometry and Newton statements retained as explicit imported inputs.

complementary_source.conclusion: No mathematical defect found in the stated completed-root source upper bounds.
complementary_source.final_integration: Author reports only typography after mathematical read; final hashes recorded separately from any claim of replay.
complementary_source.review_scope: Full bounded read of four paper text files, native figure and checker; source comparison with 05/B2/C and both exact verifier implementations; upstream Newton identities are explicit imports rather than a fresh ribbon-category reconstruction.

root_reading.formal: Read the actual reduced matrix/zero-extension identities, energy positivity, finite-dimensional inverse and unique free-vertex solution. Arbitrary root right-hand side is unused; no root equation or uniform inverse bound is claimed.
root_reading.geometry: Read all three mathematical sources, checker and rendered native figures. Checked classical shear/Hessian, full rational group continuation, compatible subdivisions and orientations, primitive multiplier signs, all main parabolic groups, independent signed IFT equations, actual small logarithmic periods before large slopes, regulator polarization and the retained filled-chain comparison.
root_reading.source: Read all four mathematical sources, figure, wrapper and the two imported rational verifiers. Checked Ward endpoints and phase normalization, both recurrence roots and collision-safe block uniformity, endpoint order of limits, both slope domains, exact domain covers, inherited losses and the macroscopic-color compactness argument.

scope: Bounded full written readings of two completed-root companions, exact finite replays and a formal reduced-Laplacian theorem. Not an end-to-end formal proof of a volume conjecture or a fresh audit of every retained reference-manuscript theorem.
